# Apollo to Present at the Bank of America 31st Annual Financials CEO Conference


September 11, 2026 8:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://ir.apollo.com/_assets/_fbe8970635fb057ef8e0a9b2c1a96a4f/apollo/news/2026-09-11_Apollo_to_Present_at_the_Bank_of_America_31st_647.pdf)


NEW YORK, Sept. 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Apollo (NYSE: APO) today announced that Marc Rowan, Chief Executive Officer and Chair of the board of Apollo, will participate in a fireside chat at the Bank of America 31st Annual Financials CEO Conference on Wednesday, September 23, 2026 at 6:00 am EDT.


A live webcast of the event will be available on Apollo’s Investor Relations website at[ir.apollo.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=fOzRhjBrrdqVf6f-ib-Y43YbRkNYP_yXnRy_APKg1Wlt282hvaEJaVNH7zlVrg9fB3JMCBPJ29Zn9ndLri2QrA==) . For those unable to join live, a replay will be available shortly after the event.


**About Apollo**


Apollo is a high-growth, global alternative asset manager. In our asset management business, we seek to provide our clients excess return at every point along the risk-reward spectrum from investment grade credit to private equity. For more than three decades, our investing expertise across our fully integrated platform has served the financial return needs of our clients and provided businesses with innovative capital solutions for growth. Through Athene, our retirement services business, we specialize in helping clients achieve financial security by providing a suite of retirement savings products and acting as a solutions provider to institutions. Our patient, creative, and knowledgeable approach to investing aligns our clients, businesses we invest in, our employees, and the communities we impact, to expand opportunity and achieve positive outcomes. As of June 30, 2026, Apollo had approximately $1.05 trillion of assets under management. To learn more, please visit[www.apollo.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=8VyKx453EvxvHYUFuSIT_1ywvZIdIfYD78P_-kYSzC_ehiFGH6_SMO6iG3CRRdsw9EvBrE-HwmCDIt0aY7-vQQ==) .
